identityTest.stableIdentity: A reusable versioned expectation definition remains identifiable without a position or occupant.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to role scope, grade expectation, competency requirements or applicability create a successor version.

invariants: A role profile may exist without a position or occupant.
Every expectation pins its governing definition version.
Grade expectations pin a grade-scheme version and level.
Competency expectations pin competency and proficiency-scale versions.
Expectations are requirements, not claims about occupants.
Position applicability is explicit and time-bounded.
Unknown occupant capability is never inferred from a role expectation.
